ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Investigations and repairs are expected to be underway, with possible disruptions to flight schedules and increased scrutiny on pilot training and airport safety protocols
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: This incident may lead to a review of taxiway design and safety procedures at Antalya Airport, as well as increased emphasis on pilot training and adherence to standard operating procedures
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Potential delays and cancellations of Turkish Airlines flights, as well as increased costs for repairs and possible changes to airport operations and safety protocols
